modelLiteralReview.interpretation: Historical Samsung symbol-dialog alignment branch is inside /*...*/ in both files; active code chooses x=LcdWidth-4 and ALIGN_RIGHT. In2.12 the subsequent close-label draw calls are also commented. It is not an active device compensation.

opcodeHeaderReview.enumStatus: Entire Dynamic library opcode enumeration is commented out, annotated SJKim050519. Not a legacy runtime dispatch table.

widthGuards.GNEX_VM_FEATURE_QUICK_OPCODE: Defined in aa2807; ab2807 selects WORD BASE_TYPE, GNEX_N_OPCODE0xF5, INC_COUNTER(a)=a>>1.
widthGuards.elseBranch: BYTE BASE_TYPE, GNEX_N_OPCODE154, INC_COUNTER(a)=a. Both branches define GVM_N_OPCODE239.
widthGuards.header: S_HeaderType2 is the GNEX128-byte layout with11 DWORD events,8-byte variable and12-byte media descriptors. It is not the Sanyo v1 52-byte header/16-bit stack format.

opcodeHeaderReview.limit: The header enum cannot name SanyoBA/BB/C4; separate native MASM dataflow below provides those names.

legacyMasm.scope: Static SDK legacy MASM opcode/name mapping, independently verified against descriptor codes and a one-byte emission path. No vendor executable executed; this is not a claim of identical platform callbacks on all handsets.
legacyMasm.nativeDataflow: At VA0x403948 the emitter reads an internal instruction opcode WORD. It searches the first BYTE of28-byte descriptors from0x412248, then VA0x40396b indexes the corresponding name pointer at0x415d9c. VA0x40398b reads the same opcode, VA0x403990 calls0x4092c0. In the direct byte-output branch, 0x409360 passes count1 to0x4092f0;0x409301/303 copies one byte to output. Selected descriptor opcode values equal BA/BB/C4, so their names are not inferred from array position alone.

compilerSignatures.limit: Raw type codes preserved; names/signature records do not alone define handset callback semantics.

crossSourceInterpretation.BA: The MASM name LockChatMode and one-argument compiler signature are consistent with Sanyo native pop-one-word/store-low-byte. This supersedes a debug-display guess for the API name, not the verified native behavior.
crossSourceInterpretation.BB: MASM names opcode0xBB SetChatMode; separate Sanyo implementation still needs its own native semantics.
crossSourceInterpretation.C4: MASM names opcode0xC4 BackToBrowser with one-argument compiler signature; compatible with Sanyo string/resource callback then event exit. Callback ABI/bounds and exact behavior on LG are not established by naming alone.

signedSystem.sqliteResult: Both8KiB signedsystem.s3db copies contain empty user/project tables and no device/capability roster. Account fields, keys and credentials are not exported into this evidence.
signedSystem.workbookResult: A WIPI/GNEX verification test-case guide, not a handset list. Generic width categories128/176/240/320 are not model identities.
